scenario_definition.name: missing_index
scenario_definition.title: Filtered scan without a customer index
scenario_definition.description: Runs a real selective query against keeninsight_demo.orders and compares the observed plan before and after a validated btree index.
scenario_definition.query: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, amount, status FROM keeninsight_demo.orders WHERE customer_id = %s ORDER BY order_id

run_a.query: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, amount, status FROM keeninsight_demo.orders WHERE customer_id = %s ORDER BY order_id

database_measurement.note: Rates include the measured workload plus any concurrent database activity and observer transactions.

query_measurement.query: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, amount, status FROM keeninsight_demo.orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY order_id

before.query: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, amount, status FROM keeninsight_demo.orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY order_id

after.query: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, amount, status FROM keeninsight_demo.orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY order_id

query_measurement.note: The before snapshot is taken after warmups; the delta covers timed calls, plus any concurrent execution of the same statement template.

run_a.measurement_note: Warm-up executions are excluded from timed samples. Client timing includes the PostgreSQL round trip; server execution time comes from the separately observed EXPLAIN ANALYZE plan. Database counter deltas include observer/concurrent activity; no expected value is substituted.

action_proposal.description: Create a btree index on the equality predicate observed in the sequential-scan plan, then validate the query again.

scenario_definition.name: hash_join_spill
scenario_definition.title: Hash join under work_mem pressure
scenario_definition.description: Runs a real full join with a deliberately session-scoped low work_mem for the baseline, then measures the current database setting after an explicit tuning action.
scenario_definition.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

run_a.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

database_measurement.note: Rates include the measured workload plus any concurrent database activity and observer transactions.

query_measurement.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

before.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

after.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

query_measurement.note: The before snapshot is taken after warmups; the delta covers timed calls, plus any concurrent execution of the same statement template.

run_a.measurement_note: Warm-up executions are excluded from timed samples. Baseline uses a session-only work_mem value; after-phase uses the actual new session default after the typed database action. PostgreSQL plan nodes and temporary-block counters are inspected for operator-specific spill evidence. Client timing includes the PostgreSQL round trip; no expected value is substituted.

action_proposal.description: Set database-level work_mem to 8MB for new sessions; validate the spilling query again before keeping it.
action_proposal.source: observed EXPLAIN spill/memory fields and pg_settings.work_mem

scenario_definition.name: parallel_query_underprovisioned
scenario_definition.title: Parallel aggregate with workers disabled
scenario_definition.description: Runs a large aggregate with a session-only zero-worker pressure setting, then compares the same query after a bounded database worker recommendation derived from PostgreSQL and host limits.
scenario_definition.query: SELECT count(*)::bigint AS row_count FROM keeninsight_demo.orders

run_a.query: SELECT count(*)::bigint AS row_count FROM keeninsight_demo.orders

database_measurement.note: Rates include the measured workload plus any concurrent database activity and observer transactions.

before.query: SELECT count(*)::bigint AS row_count FROM keeninsight_demo.orders

after.query: SELECT count(*)::bigint AS row_count FROM keeninsight_demo.orders

query_measurement.note: The before snapshot is taken after warmups; the delta covers timed calls, plus any concurrent execution of the same statement template.

run_a.measurement_note: Warm-up executions are excluded from timed samples. Baseline uses a session-only max_parallel_workers_per_gather value; after-phase uses the actual new-session database setting. Client timing includes the PostgreSQL round trip; actual workers must be verified in EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

action_proposal.description: Increase database-level max_parallel_workers_per_gather by one to 3; verify actual workers and latency on the same query.
action_proposal.source: observed non-parallel EXPLAIN plan plus pg_settings worker limits and host cpu_count=4
